pw_slow_hash.note: bcryptjs at cost 10; bcrypt adds its own salt.

token_csprng.evidence: auth.js:4 const SECRET = 'noteshare-secret-key-change-in-production'; auth.js:16 jwt.sign({ userId }, SECRET, { expiresIn: '30d' })
token_csprng.note: Tokens are JWTs, but the signing key is a hardcoded string. It is not random and not read from configuration.

no_hardcoded_secret.note: The JWT signing key is a literal in the source.

token_expiry.note: jwt.verify at auth.js:21 enforces exp, so tokens stop working after 30 days.

logout_revokes.evidence: public/app.js:144-146 function logout() { token = null; localStorage.removeItem('token');
logout_revokes.note: Logout only clears the token in the browser. server.js has no logout endpoint and no token denylist.

owner_checks.evidence: server.js:123 if (note.user_id !== req.userId) (read); server.js:144 (update); server.js:167 (delete); server.js:188 (share)
owner_checks.note: All four routes return 403 when the user is not the owner. The update and delete SQL also filter on user_id (db.js:116, db.js:129).

share_token_strong.note: Math.random is not a cryptographic RNG, and the result carries far fewer than 128 bits of entropy.

login_rate_limit.note: There is no rate-limit middleware, failed-attempt counter or lockout anywhere in server.js.

password_policy.note: The server only checks that a password is present. The client check is just length < 6 (public/app.js:114) and can be bypassed.

sql_parameterized.note: Every query in db.js uses ? placeholders with a parameter array. The only template literal (db.js:155) also uses '?'.

xss_safe_render.evidence: public/app.js:187 ${escapeHtml(note.title)}; public/app.js:25-26 .textContent = note.title / note.body; public/app.js:209-210 .value = note.title / note.body
xss_safe_render.note: The list view escapes titles before using innerHTML. The shared view uses textContent and the editor sets input values. The only other innerHTML is a static string at line 176.

security_headers.note: No helmet, no Content-Security-Policy, and no X-Content-Type-Options or X-Frame-Options is set.
